rules.summary: Up to 500-1500 points of Scintillating Legions; they give nearby Psykers a 4+ invulnerable against shooting and share Rituals

enhancements.name: Diabolic Savant
enhancements.summary: Near Scintillating Legions (6"): +1 to its Psychic tests when Channelling the Warp

enhancements.name: Duplicitous Malediction
enhancements.summary: After deployment, redeploy up to three units, even into Strategic Reserves

enhancements.name: Nethershriek Mind-Eater
enhancements.summary: Start of your Shooting phase: a visible enemy 12" or closer tests Battle-shock, 3 mortal wounds if it fails

enhancements.name: Tome of True Names
enhancements.summary: Once per battle, for one phase: 2+ invulnerable save

rules.name: Kindred Sorcery

options.name: Imbued Manifestation: +6" range for Psychic weapons
Psychic Maelstrom: +1 to wound with Psychic weapons
Wrath of the Immaterium: Psychic weapons gain Devastating Wounds

rules.summary: Command phase, each once per battle: +6" Psychic range, +1 to wound with Psychic weapons, or Devastating Wounds

enhancements.name: Eldritch Vortex of E’Taph
enhancements.summary: +1 S and Damage for its Psychic weapons

enhancements.name: Incandaeum
enhancements.summary: Once per battle, may attempt Doombolt even if already attempted

enhancements.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
enhancements.summary: +6" range for its Rituals

enhancements.name: Umbralefic Crystal
enhancements.summary: Once per battle, Command phase, unengaged: into Strategic Reserves, back by ingress

rules.name: Flow of Magic
rules.summary: Psychic attacks re-roll 1s to wound, or +1 to wound wholly in your Flow of Magic

enhancements.name: Arcane Might
enhancements.summary: +1 S for its unit’s Psychic weapons (+2 in the Flow of Magic)

enhancements.name: Empowered Manifestation
enhancements.summary: In the Flow of Magic: +6" Psychic range, and re-roll Hazardous tests

enhancements.name: Empyric Onslaught
enhancements.summary: In the Flow of Magic: +3 Attacks for its ranged Psychic weapons

enhancements.name: Noctilith Mantle
enhancements.summary: Its unit is always in the Flow of Magic but cannot use Rituals

rules.name: Sorcerous Invigoration
rules.summary: Once per turn, a Psyker unit that manifests a Ritual heals D3 wounds

enhancements.name: Curse of Life
enhancements.summary: Heals 3 more from Sorcerous Invigoration

enhancements.name: Eruption of Vitality
enhancements.summary: Once per battle: returns alone with 3 wounds on a 2+ once the phase ends

rules.name: All is Dust
rules.summary: Rubricae get +1 to armour saves against Damage 1 attacks

enhancements.name: Arcane Thralls
enhancements.summary: Rubricae 9" or closer re-roll Battle-shock tests

enhancements.name: Lord of the Rubricae
enhancements.summary: Leading: Rubricae get +1 to hit

enhancements.name: Risen Rubricae
enhancements.summary: Two Rubricae Battleline units, or one other Rubricae unit, gain Infiltrators

enhancements.name: Stave Abominus
enhancements.summary: Thousand Sons Infantry only

rules.name: Ensorcelled Animus
rules.summary: Sekhetar Robots’ attacks are Psychic, with +1 WS in melee near a Psyker (12")

enhancements.name: Occulus Infernum
enhancements.summary: Movement phase: Sekhetar Robots 6" or closer get +1 BS until your next turn

enhancements.name: Walking Rampart
enhancements.summary: Heals nearby Sekhetar Robots D3+1 wounds; Lone Operative beside them

rules.name: All-Seeing Mutant Hordes
rules.summary: Tzaangors are Battleline; enemies get +6" detection range against shooting Mutants

enhancements.name: Thicket of Bladed Bone
enhancements.summary: +1 AP and Cleave 1 in melee

enhancements.name: Unravelled Fates
enhancements.summary: Movement phase: frees a Mutant unit 6" or closer from Battle-shock

rules.name: Warpfire Infusion
rules.summary: Vehicles get one re-roll among hit, wound and Damage dice (one of each near a Psyker); near one, they explode on 5+

enhancements.name: Biomechanical Mutation
enhancements.summary: Command phase: a Vehicle 6" or closer regains up to D3 wounds

enhancements.name: Perplexing Cloak
enhancements.summary: Thousand Sons Infantry only

enhancements.name: Warp Syphon
enhancements.summary: Near a Vehicle: re-roll its Channel the Warp die for a mortal wound on that Vehicle

enhancements.name: Warp-Cursed Runemaster
enhancements.summary: Near a Vehicle: +6" range for its Rituals

rules.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice
rules.summary: Tzeentch Mutants may take D3 mortal wounds: -1 to wound them, or +1 to wound; Tzaangors are Battleline with +1 OC

enhancements.name: Bray Lord
enhancements.summary: Scouts 6"

enhancements.name: Diamond of Distortion
enhancements.summary: Leading: attacks against its unit get -1 to hit

enhancements.name: Flowing Flesh
enhancements.summary: Feel No Pain 4+ and 5 Wounds

enhancements.name: Warpmeld Dagger
enhancements.summary: Takes D3 mortal wounds to add as much to a Psychic test

stratagems.name: ARCANE FOCUS
stratagems.summary: Re-roll every die of a Psychic test

stratagems.name: ARCANE VENTING
stratagems.summary: An objective it controls is secured

stratagems.name: ARDENT AUTOMATA
stratagems.summary: Fell Back: can still shoot and charge this turn

stratagems.name: BLESSED TRANSMUTATIONS
stratagems.summary: A Tzaangors unit 12" or closer gets up to D3+1 models back

stratagems.name: CHRONOSORCEROUS BLEED
stratagems.summary: A visible enemy 12" or closer gets -1 to its charge rolls

stratagems.name: CYBERSPIRIT MACHINATIONS
stratagems.summary: Fell Back near a Psyker: can still shoot and charge this turn

stratagems.name: DECEPTIVE GLAMOUR
stratagems.summary: Engaged enemies must attack Scintillating Legions first if they can

stratagems.name: DERANGED FEROCITY
stratagems.summary: Piles in and consolidates 6"; models 3" or closer to the enemy can fight

stratagems.name: DESECRATION OF WORLDS
stratagems.summary: Its objective stays yours until the enemy out-controls it

stratagems.name: DESTINED BY FATE
stratagems.summary: A failed save on the Psyker: that attack deals no damage

stratagems.name: DEVASTATING SORCERY
stratagems.summary: +9" Psychic range, and re-roll hits and wounds with Psychic weapons

stratagems.name: ECTOPLASMIC EXTRUSION
stratagems.summary: Starting an action does not stop it from shooting

stratagems.name: EGOTISTICAL POWER
stratagems.summary: Takes a Kindred Sorcery ability of its own, even one already used

stratagems.name: ENSORCELLED INFUSION
stratagems.summary: Near a Psyker: ranged weapons become Psychic with +1 to wound

stratagems.name: ETHEREAL PHANTASM
stratagems.summary: An enemy ends a move 8" or closer: a D6" Normal move (6" near Thousand Sons)

stratagems.name: FRACTAL DISJUNCTION
stratagems.summary: Can only be shot from 18" or closer this phase

stratagems.name: GIFT OF CHANGE
stratagems.summary: Once per battle round, a slain Character becomes a Tzeentch Chaos Spawn

stratagems.name: GLIMMERSHIFT PORTAL
stratagems.summary: Two units, or one Monster, 6" from enemies: back into Strategic Reserves

stratagems.name: HEX-MARKED ARMOUR
stratagems.summary: Attacks against it lose 1 AP until the attacker is done

stratagems.name: IMPLACABLE GUARDIANS
stratagems.summary: -1 Damage to attacks allocated to non-Psyker models this phase

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.summary: Ignores Move and Advance penalties; ranged weapons gain Assault this turn

stratagems.name: INFERNAL FUSILLADE
stratagems.summary: Inferno bolt weapons become Psychic with Strength 5 this phase

stratagems.name: KALEIDOSCOPIC TEMPEST
stratagems.summary: Stealth, and -3" detection range in the Flow of Magic

stratagems.name: MALEVOLENT ANIMUS
stratagems.summary: Near a Psyker: ignores modifiers to its characteristics and rolls (saves excepted)

stratagems.name: MULTITUDINOUS LIMBS
stratagems.summary: Advancing or Falling Back does not stop it from starting an action

stratagems.name: MUTAGENIC MAGICKS
stratagems.summary: One engaged enemy: six D6, each 4+ a mortal wound

stratagems.name: MUTATE LANDSCAPE
stratagems.summary: Its objective stays yours and is mutated: enemies moving onto it take D3 mortal wounds on 4+

stratagems.name: PRISMATIC DISPLACEMENT
stratagems.summary: Ranged weapons gain Assault, and its move does not stop it from shooting or charging

stratagems.name: PSYCHIC DOMINION
stratagems.summary: The attacker’s Psychic weapons gain Hazardous; Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic attacks

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS REBIRTH
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds

stratagems.name: REVENGE OF THE RUBRICAE
stratagems.summary: A Psyker 6" or closer was shot dead: the Rubricae shoot back at the killer

stratagems.name: SCOURING WARPFLAME
stratagems.summary: In the Flow of Magic: Ignores Cover, and one unit it hits loses cover

stratagems.name: STRANDS OF TIME
stratagems.summary: Fell Back: can shoot or charge (both in the Flow of Magic) this turn

stratagems.name: SULPHUROUS VEIL
stratagems.summary: Attacks against it get -1 to hit this phase

stratagems.name: TEMPORAL INSTABILITY
stratagems.summary: Advancing or Falling Back does not stop it from starting an action

stratagems.name: THE LAND WRITHES
stratagems.summary: Mobile

stratagems.name: THROUGH THE VEIL
stratagems.summary: Rubric Marines gain Deep Strike; Scarabs land in the Flow of Magic 6" from enemies

stratagems.name: TOUCHED BY TZEENTCH
stratagems.summary: Can shoot or charge after Advancing this turn

stratagems.name: TWISTED MIRAGE
stratagems.summary: Arrives from Strategic Reserves 6" from enemies (8" for Monsters), no charge

stratagems.name: UNWAVERING PHALANX
stratagems.summary: Charged: attacks against it get -1 to wound this turn

stratagems.name: WARDING HEX
stratagems.summary: Its objective in the Flow of Magic stays yours until the enemy out-controls it

stratagems.name: WARP FIELDS
stratagems.summary: Ranged attacks stronger than its Toughness get -1 to wound

stratagems.name: WARPED VICISSITUDE
stratagems.summary: 4+ invulnerable save this phase

stratagems.name: WARPFLAME GARGOYLES
stratagems.summary: Charged: six D6, each 5+ a mortal wound, then the charger tests Battle-shock

stratagems.name: WRATH OF THE DOOMED
stratagems.summary: Slain before fighting: still fights on a 4+ (+1 in the Flow of Magic)
